name: Ring of Preparation
body:
Price 56,000 gp; Aura moderate universal; CL 7; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring is carved from a single piece of polished stone or coral and serves as a quickly accessible source of spells. When preparing spells for the day, a prepared spellcaster can instill three spells of any level that they can normally prepare into the ring. As a move action, the wearer of the ring can prepare one of the spells stored in the ring in an empty spell slot of the appropriate level. The spell cannot be transferred into an expended spell slot and the wearer must be able to cast the spell normally via their own spell list. For example, a wizard could leave a 3rd-level slot open and if the ring had fireball, dispel magic, or heroism, they could prepare it in their open slot as a move action. On the other hand, a cleric could not use the same ring to prepare the fireball or heroism spells.

If the spell is given to a spontaneous caster, they treat the spells stored within as a spell known so long as the spells are on their spell list.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 28,000 gp; Feats Forge Ring, mnemonic enhancer
